notes: «أن زيد بن خالد الجهني، أرسله إلى أبي جهيم» describes Zayd's action (rule 6): scene, not a link; Abu Jahim is the one who relays the Prophet's words
The text gives no «عن» between بسر بن سعيد and أبو جهيم; the route is read from the sending story, so the gap is noted
«قال أبو النضر لا أدري...» is a wording doubt, not a route
